notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
🔥CRAZY BEATS, THRILLING RHYTHM ACTION!🔥

Hello everyone! This is CeREELs from Ella Stars.

Since the demo release of Ella Stars on April 8, 2025, we've gathered feedback from our players and made several updates to create a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience. Here are the changes:

1. Demo Songs Updated
The previous tracks 'Don’t Give Up Never Give Up' and 'Got a Job' have been replaced with
'Play Together' and 'Bird Get into a Fight'.

2. Song Difficulty Adjusted
We’ve lowered the difficulty level to make the game more accessible.

3. Sync Optimization
Note timing and sync have been improved for a more precise rhythm experience.

At CeREELs, we always listen to our players and are constantly working to deliver the most exciting rhythm action gameplay possible.
We truly appreciate your feedback and continued support.

Thank you! 🎵

notes.title: Ella Stars Demo Released!
notes.content:
🔥CRAZY BEATS, THRILLING RHYTHM ACTION!🔥

Hello everyone~! This is CeREELs from Ella Stars!
After a long time of dedicated development, the demo version of Ella Stars is finally available!
We’re excited to share the details of the demo below—have fun playing Ella Stars!

🌟 Out-Game Overview
1. Playable Songs in Demo (Total: 2 Songs)
- Don't Give Up Never Give Up (Difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard)
- Got a Job (Difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard, Crazy)

🔓 Unlock Order: Easy → Normal → Hard → Crazy

2. Playable Skins
- Ella: Basic Ella, Hawaii Ella, Reggae Ella (3 types total)
- Basic Ella: Unlocked by default
- Hawaii Ella: Unlock by hitting 850 notes
- Reggae Ella: Unlock after playing 3 games with any equipped skin
- Bird: Basic Bird (1 type, unlocked by default)
- Skin Unlock Condition: Clear "Don’t Give Up Never Give Up" once

3. Customizable Settings
- Supported Languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish (5 languages total)
- Hit Sound Effects: 3 types available
- Frame Rate Options: 60Hz, 120Hz, 144Hz
- Display Modes: Windowed, Fullscreen, Borderless Window
- Fine Sync Adjustment feature available
- Key Binding customization supported

4. Achievements
- A total of 19 achievements available

🌟 In-Game Features
1. Finish System
- A dazzling finish effect appears when you hit the Finish Note at the moment the boss’s HP reaches zero
- The finish animation changes depending on the equipped skin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359988/acb7460cdc2602c544268a1aa12654784fb56989.jpg[/img]

2. Skill Immunity System
- You can nullify interference skills used by villains
- The villains you can counter vary depending on the skin you’re using

3. Villain Interference Skills
- Villains use a variety of disruption skills like hiding or blocking notes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359988/68f4bf0ee354fb6b3534998d1fbc380c8d07d5c5.jpg[/img]

4. Combo System

5. Fever System
- When you maintain a combo of 10 or more, the Fever timer won’t decrease

6. Scoring System
- Score is affected by Fever status, Combo count, and Finish success

7. Rank (Accuracy) System
- You’ll be awarded a rank based on accuracy: F, C, B, A, S, SS, SSS, EX

notes.title: Ella Stars Game Feature #1
notes.content:
🔥 CRAZY BEATS, THRILLING RHYTHM ACTION! 🔥

Hello, this is CeREELs from Ella Stars!

Today, we’d like to introduce some of the key features of Ella Stars.
The most distinctive aspect of the game is the combination of immersive storytelling and the satisfying impact of rhythmic action!

📝 Storytelling
Ella embarks on a busking journey with her companion, Bird, to find their own exhilarating beats.
However, the Dis-Buskers and Noise-Masters, who seek to destroy music, are running rampant.
As a result, the beautiful melodies are on the verge of being distorted and turned into mere noise.

As the player, you will travel through various cities alongside Ella and Bird,
defeating villains with thrilling rhythms, restoring balance to the distorted world of music, and ultimately creating your own unique beat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359988/12c0c532ec35311166e90e19b09da680d74bec09.gif[/img]

💥 Rhythmic Rhythm Action
-Hit the notes in sync with the rhythm
-Single-tap note actions provide a satisfying impact
-Exciting sound effects when hitting notes
-Villain skills add challenging obstacles to battles
-Dynamic villain finishers for a thrilling climax

Let the beat drop and experience the ultimate rhythm action adventure! 🎶🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359988/ca8fbd937fe53e20c6f1ab90d54dc89a296b1541.gif[/img]

notes.title: Nice to meet you! Ella Stars
notes.content:
🔥CRAZY BEATS, THRILLING RHYTHM ACTION!🔥

Hello everyone! Ella Stars is our first game on Steam!

We’re CeREELs, the team behind Ella Stars.

[About Ella Gator IP] 
The main character of our exciting rhythm game, Ella gator, comes from our [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CeREELs]CeREELs[/url] YouTube channel, where she’s been featured in Seasons 1 through 10. These animated music videos have gained a lot of love from fans all around the world!

At first glance, Ella might look like an alligator, but she’s got small wings and can even breathe fire, which definitely makes her stand out.

Sometimes, though, being different can feel lonely and frustrating. There are moments when Ella struggles with the fact that she’s not like the others. But whenever she starts feeling down, she listens to upbeat music to lift her spirits and keep going!

Ella isn’t alone, though. She has her trusty friend, Bird, who always sticks by her side. Together, they set out on an adventure to find a place where Ella truly belongs.

As they journey through a world filled with music and excitement, Ella gradually realizes something important:

It’s not about what you look like on the outside. What really matters is who you choose to be.

Join Ella and Bird as they set off on a musical adventure to discover their true selves—because, in the end, identity isn’t something that’s given to you. It’s something you create for yourself! 🎶✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45359988/42a177ffbe692c0ffc7ba459f549215a6f56be13.jpg[/img]
